Incoterms 2020

बंकर समायोजन

A surcharge applied by carriers to account for fluctuations in marine fuel (bunker) prices.

Definition

A surcharge applied by carriers to account for fluctuations in marine fuel (bunker) prices.

Operational example

A bunker adjustment factor was added to the freight invoice after a rise in global fuel prices.
